title: okf-strategy — Common Definitions
description: Shared building blocks. Payload bodies are arrays of native ClearPoint shapes (element, elementStatus, linkedElements, measureSeries) using ClearPoint's own field names (object, objectId, scorecardId, periodId, ...). Parsing provenance — how each id was resolved and with what confidence — lives in a sibling `_map` keyed by field name, so a body is a drop-in ClearPoint shape once `_map` and `ref`s are resolved away.

objectType.description: ClearPoint element type. Mirrors the `object` enum in api/v1/doc/schema/element.json.

elementHandle.description: Points to an element: `ref` (created earlier in this batch) OR {object, objectId} (existing). scorecardId aids routing/disambiguation.

customFieldData.description: A custom field value write. Mirrors api/v1/doc/schema/customFieldData.json: {object, objectId, customFieldId, periodId?, value}. `value` is ALWAYS a string (displayValue is read-only and never written; serialize numbers/dates/bools to their string form). Include `periodId` for period-scoped UPDATE values (status pass); omit/empty it for non-period EDIT-field values (element-level custom fields).

objectId.description: Target element id (existing). Omit/null when using `ref`.

ref.description: Target element created earlier in this run.

fieldRef.description: ref of a custom field defined earlier in this batch.

periodId.description: Present for period-scoped update-field values; omit/null for edit-field (non-period) values.

value.description: Always a string. HTML for rich-text fields; serialized form for numeric/date/boolean fields.

evidence.description: Where in the source document a value or mapping came from. Required on every resolved reference for audit.

locator.description: Finer locator: spreadsheet cell, heading path, char offset.

selector.description: Human-readable description of WHICH existing object was meant. Both the matching input and the audit record of what was matched against the lookup manifest.

scorecardPath.description: Breadcrumb to disambiguate, e.g. 'Finance > Improve cash flow'.

resolution.description: How a single id-bearing field was resolved. Either `ref` -> an object minted earlier in this batch, or `selector`+`confidence` -> matched against the lookup manifest. Below the confidence threshold the id field MUST be null and a record added to envelope.unresolved. NEVER invent an id.

map.description: Provenance sidecar. Keys are field names in the same object (e.g. 'objectId', 'periodId', 'statusId', 'scorecardId'); values describe how each was resolved. Stripped before the body is sent to ClearPoint.
